notes: One row per ICAO aircraft type designator (sheet ACD_Data). Source units kept: feet, pounds, knots.
aac = Aircraft Approach Category (A–E, from approach speed); adg = Airplane Design Group (I–VI, from wingspan and tail height); tdg = Taxiway Design Group; icaoWtc = ICAO wake-turbulence category.
wingspan_ft = without winglets/sharklets, wingspanWinglets_ft = with; one of the two may be null.
Intended by the FAA for airport planning and design; values are not certification data.
